reviews.text: Very scrupulous, precise, passionate, reliable.

Highly valued professionals, every time you come in with your little bundle of joy, they listen to you and reassure you. Always available, even when they're struggling with sleep and perhaps dealing with somewhat rude "parents." Thank you for everything you do and give. Thank you, dear Roberta, for welcoming everyone with care and being the first face we see. You are all wonderful, first with Indy and now with Elf 😍

One of the best in Milan. Serious, competent, and honest. Both Dr. Brocchi and the other specialists are very knowledgeable. Their love for animals is immediately evident. Coming here makes me feel safe for my pets. I highly recommend them in Milan, where, unfortunately, not everyone is at this level.

I can't recommend this veterinary clinic highly enough.
Drs. Brusasco and Brocchi took care of my cat with truly exceptional kindness and professionalism.
I've never encountered such attentive, competent, and helpful veterinarians. The entire staff has always been very friendly, too.
I'm truly happy to have found this clinic in Milan for my cat.

She's very empathetic with animals and their owners.
Competence and complete peace of mind make this a truly important experience for those who love their pets.

I had a great experience with Dr. Brocchi. He was very kind, compassionate, and attentive. He listened to my dog's entire medical history, reassuring me and offering me the best solutions. I'm truly happy to have found this clinic so close to home.

I can only recommend the Aurora Veterinary Clinic with all my heart.

Dr. Brocchi has been my vet since Myrea was just a puppy, and I will always be grateful to him. I came to him desperate. Myrea, my Border Collie, was full of giardia, wouldn't eat anything, and after consulting three other vets, no one had been able to resolve the situation.
He was the only one who truly understood the problem and helped us out of what had become a nightmare for me.
Today, Myrea is 18 months old and in perfect shape, full of energy and health... and I owe this to him.
The clinic is modern, equipped with cutting-edge technology, and always impeccable.
A special thanks also to Roberta, his assistant, who was extremely kind, always available, and ready to help me, especially in times of emergency, when I needed it most.
Professionalism, competence, and love for me—the best 🐾🐶 for our beloved furry friends.

After a bad experience I was looking for a vet who was structurally prepared but at the same time who could put my super active dog with quicksilver in his body at ease... and on the suggestion of friends I found Dr. Brocchi to be an exceptional and very human person as he had been described to me... (Even though I hadn't asked for him when I booked, he didn't wait long for me to examine him) The only shame was for the lady who welcomed me and gave me an invoice who, despite not knowing me, made some unpleasant remarks with grimaces and left only because I had said I was happy to have waited for Dr. Brocchi and according to her, they are all good, especially the female doctors... they certainly are, but it was the first time I had come!

I would like to sincerely thank the Aurora Veterinary Clinic, Dr. Francesca Valbonesi, who quickly diagnosed the disease and carefully supervised the cat's treatment, helping to prolong the life of my beloved cat; Dr. Roberto Murgo, who worked even during the holidays to preserve the health of two furry friends; and all the staff.
They are a very attentive, sensitive, and professional team, who care for animals and their owners with great respect, sensitivity, and humanity.
The clinic is well-equipped. You can sense their genuine attention to each individual animal and their genuine commitment to their well-being.
A special thank you for the warm and attentive care given to my cat, Salon. During a difficult time, he was surrounded by attention, calm, and professionalism, and this meant the world to me.
By entrusting your pet to the care of the doctors at this clinic, you can rest assured: your pet will be in safe hands.

I sincerely wish health to all the little furry patients and thank the entire team for their work, their humanity and sincere love for animals ❤️‍🩹🙏

Top experience, very friendly and professional.
I've never been afraid to put my heart in their hands.
Excellent clinic, I recommend it.

I thank Dr. Brocchi, who has been treating my dog ​​for years. He is very professional and, above all, passionate, kind, and has a big heart. My dog ​​has undergone surgery several times and is personally cared for by him. I also thank his staff, especially Roberta, who is always kind, helpful, and professional. I have recommended him to several friends who have been very happy with him. He will always be my trusted veterinarian. Congratulations, the Aurora Clinic, for me, is the best in Milan.

I'm Zar, and today, surrounded by the love of Eugenio and Piera (my humans) and the gentle care of Dr. Brocchi and Dr. Della Grotta, I fell asleep. I'm so grateful to all the staff at the Aurora Veterinary Clinic for the care, expertise, and love you gave me. I couldn't have asked for anything better ❤️
You can see they love animals: very well prepared, very kind, very efficient. Rating from 1 to 10: 12

I wanted to thank Dr. Valeria Avolio and the entire team, who yesterday, in addition to their undoubted expertise and professionalism, showed great humanity in helping me and my family come to terms with the sudden loss of our 13-year-old mixed-breed dog, Sissy, who suddenly passed away from a serious illness and for whom they did everything they could.

Thank you
Giovanna and family

Average prices and great professionalism. In 2016, they treated and saved my kitten. The clinic is fully equipped and they know how to treat cats without causing them any trauma. Extremely competent, highly recommended.

I've known Dr. Brocchi and his staff (Dr. Murgo, Dr. Avolio, Dr. Valbonesi) for over 30 years (even my mother went to him). Although the clinic has now moved and expanded, it has never lost its human touch because it is not owned by a shareholder group, which allows it to make independent decisions. For this reason, even though I've lived more than 60 km away for over 20 years, I still prefer it to other, closer facilities. I can never express enough my gratitude to Dr. Brocchi and his staff, even those who have been working with him more recently.

I don't think a few lines and five stars can truly do this clinic justice. A friend recommended it to me when my 5-year-old French bulldog developed acute neck pain, after extensive checkups elsewhere. It's a small clinic, but it offers a family atmosphere where, despite everything, there's an atmosphere of trust and cordiality. We were treated by Dr. Lorenzo Brocchi, an internist and neurologist, who has become our primary veterinarian. He's a young doctor, but one from another era, highly knowledgeable, reassuring, and very honest. After visiting so many veterinarians and clinics, this isn't something you'd expect. He's a very compassionate doctor, both with the patient and, especially, with us companions. He explains everything in detail and is always very helpful. I recommend this clinic and, especially, our doctor...a rare gem!

I'd like to give 10 stars! They saved my miniature schnauzer from certain death. I went in thinking he'd ingested poison at the park, but instead they diagnosed acute pancreatitis with extreme professionalism and promptness, requiring immediate hospitalization. They organized everything for me in half an hour! I also thank you from the bottom of my heart for your kindness. I couldn't have dreamed of better assistance and professionalism. Thank you!!!
I loved the professionalism; the doctor was impeccable. I felt comfortable because they speak English.
I've known Dr. Brocchi since 1980, and I'd never go to any other veterinary practice! The staff has always been excellent.

The Aurora Clinic has been my trusted veterinary clinic for over 30 years. Dr. Brocchi and his staff are wonderful people. I truly consider them a center of veterinary excellence, always ahead of their time with cutting-edge equipment in both diagnostics and treatment, not to mention pain management, and with a unique sense of humanity. They first treated my cat Nir, and now I've been coming to them for years for my cats Tom and Aaron: they couldn't be in better hands... thank you for everything you do...
Truly special clinic both humanely and for the love for animals 5 stars are not enough let's say 5 stars Luxury
Thanks to everyone

An absolutely reliable facility. Thanks to a very rapid diagnostic assessment and emergency surgery performed by Dr. Brocchi in a very short time, our Oscar, who would have already flown away after having visited 3 other facilities saying he would not even be eligible for surgery, has given us another 4 months of joy. Special thanks to the continued support and availability offered by the entire team for every issue related to our very complex case. We hope to do our best and wish all the staff great success in their professional fields! Thanks again for everything!!! When we come to the clinic I always tell Oscarino to come and say hello to our Dr. Brocchi who saved his life. ❤️

On Friday morning, I took my dog ​​Electra to the doctor at the Grotta. She told me it wasn't anything serious, just that she'd eaten things from the ground or taken strange substances, which was absolutely not true. In the evening, she released her, telling me she was confident and just sleepy.
In the end, my dog ​​died within hours. The next day, they had the nerve to say they'd misdiagnosed her, and now I'm in terrible pain. Does something like this seem normal to you? I'm reporting these people!
What can I say, wonderful, they are very good and very professional

I've been going to this clinic for four years, when they were still on Corso Sempione. I discovered it thanks to my now terminally ill Carola. They didn't give me false information, but corrected it, and we put her to sleep in my arms. …

After visiting so many vets, I trusted them, and thank goodness!
A spectacular place, extremely well-equipped and super competent!
You can tell they really care about animals! Top staff! My heart sank when I saw …
The staff is professional, dedicated, knowledgeable, and always available. Despite their large patient population and often unpredictable emergencies, the wait is never excessive. Highly recommended.
